title: Add post-hoc child/parent homework progress recording without inventing session time
prompt: Implement the confirmed Ready & Set requirement on the current isolated Ready work branch only. Real homework may happen while Ready was not open, so app execution history is not the sole authority for learning facts. Add a bounded retrospective/manual reconciliation path for both child and parent/guardian to record all or part of an existing homework task as actually completed. Preserve the existing canonical Ready session/lap owner; do NOT create a second homework session store, do NOT manufacture a Session/Lap for retrospective reports, and do NOT fabricate elapsed/focus time when no Ready session existed. Preserve provenance distinctly for automatic/session-derived results and manual reports; support CHILD_REPORTED and PARENT_REPORTED, and parent confirmation of a child report where the current model allows it without invasive redesign. Reconcile planned quantity vs actual reported quantity so partial completion reduces remaining work and can produce PARTIAL or COMPLETED without treating unrecorded app time as zero learning. Keep report timestamp/source separate from any actual-work date if the model supports it. Minimal child-friendly UI is sufficient: a small 'already did it' / 'record what I did' entry on today's homework, with whole/partial amount capture; parent surface may record or confirm. Existing automatic Ready session behavior must remain unchanged. Keep system ownership boundaries: Ready handles planning/execution/history/reconciliation; do not move Snap & Pop growth, badges, blessings, Wish Shop, diary, letters or notes into Ready. No location tracking. Add/update bounded static/contract tests for: one session owner only, provenance preserved, no invented time, partial quantity reduces remaining amount, completed quantity marks complete, and existing automatic session path still works. Work only on the configured work branch; do not switch branches, merge main, deploy production, release, or trigger paid generation. Finish with root cause/design boundary, changed files, checks run, and remaining runtime-only blocker if any.
